page.notes: Printed marginal line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 are kept as notes. The "30" beside the Sarmatia heading is not placed in the text because the marginal text is ambiguous on this line; it stands beside "IN SARMATIA". The headings are centred over the left column, so I placed them in that column; the right column runs level with them. Doubtful readings: "Taeito", "eodem lii", "Im.", and "Sorbiodunū" are marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. Printed u/v and i/j are normalised to the vowel or consonant value, so "Nouiodunum" is Noviodunum and "Iuliodunum" is Juliodunum.
